Rotor & Thermal Systems

NASA Langley wind-tunnel campaigns test rotor loads and aerodynamics. Sikorsky supports aeromechanics and flight-hardware modeling.

APL rotor testing, January 2026

Lockheed Martin's mission roles include the cruise stage and aeroshell.

Lockheed Martin mission hardware

The real lander's thermal system circulates MMRTG waste heat through insulated equipment bays and rejects excess heat through a cold duct.

Model assumptions

875 kg mass, 1.35 m rotors, 20 kWh usable battery, 0.75 figure of merit and 1.15 loss factor are demo assumptions, not qualified flight specifications. Four coaxial stations share four swept disks. Pressure and density use an isothermal near-surface approximation.

Attitude, RPM mixing, power, terrain-following altitude, instruments and radio status are illustrative. Chamber heat transfer, MMRTG charging, battery cutoff and full aerodynamic interactions are not simulated.
